integrityMechanism: Each JSONL audit event stores the SHA-256 hash of its canonical event payload and the preceding event hash.
accessControl: The fixture creates persistence and audit files with owner-only mode 0600 inside a temporary test directory.
retention: Temporary test data is retained only for the individual test and is removed in afterEach cleanup.
restoreTestEvidence: tests/transfer.test.ts reads persisted operations and audit events through a newly completed operation path during each test.
exportTestEvidence: tests/transfer.test.ts exports audit events through readAuditEvents and verifies their serialized integrity fields.
